name: Loyang Edge
summary: Loyang industrial-fringe toward Pasir Ris / Changi — quieter east living with practical hops and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Loyang Edge is the shortlist when quieter east living and Changi-side optionality matter more than Tampines mall density. The pocket sits on the Loyang / Pasir Ris / Changi edges; housing mixes mid-age HDB, older condos, and selective landed inserts. Expats land here for EWL / bus hops, airport-side convenience, and ActiveSG gateball / petanque catchment without CBD premiums. Watch-outs: smoke-stop / staircase pressurisation fan notices on mid-rises, evening industrial traffic, and confusing Loyang vs Loyang Edge shortlists. Compare with Pasir Ris West Fringe for park-connector texture, Tampines North Edge for denser new-town living, and Changi Village when coastal calm wins.
